kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أخضوضر (form XII)
# أَخْضَوْضِرُ (ʔaḵḍawḍiru) /ʔax.dˤaw.dˤi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْضَوْضَرَ (iḵḍawḍara)
# أَخْضَوْضِرَ (ʔaḵḍawḍira) /ʔax.dˤaw.dˤi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْضَوْضَرَ (iḵḍawḍara)
# أَخْضَوْضِرْ (ʔaḵḍawḍir) /ʔax.dˤaw.dˤir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِخْضَوْضَرَ (iḵḍawḍara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
